column3: “Ancestor” is rendered “father”; NASB supplies “had done.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Made smoke” is rendered “burned incense,” and “dispossessed” as “had driven out.”
“Made smoke” is rendered “burned incense,” and “luxuriant” as “green.”
“Defeated him a great defeat” is rendered “inflicted him with heavy casualties”; NASB adds “Wherefore.”
“Sons of strength” is rendered “valiant men.”
“The officer of the house” is rendered “the ruler of the house.”
“Relatives” is rendered “brethren.”
“In the wrath of Yahweh … towards Judah” is rendered “because the LORD … was angry with Judah.”
“You are saying” is rendered “you are proposing,” and “guilts” as “transgressions.”
“Relatives” is rendered “brothers.”
NASB spells “Johanan” and “Jehizkiah.”
“To the guilt of Yahweh on us you are saying” is rendered “you are proposing to bring upon us guilt against the LORD”; NASB supplies “so that” and “His.”
“The equipped man” is rendered “the armed men,” and “commanders” as “officers.”
“Any who stumbled” is rendered “all their feeble ones”; NASB supplies “with oil.”
“To help him” is rendered “for help.”
“Defeated” is rendered “attacked.”
“The Shephelah” is rendered “the lowland,” and “daughters” as “villages.”
“Allowed lack of restraint” is rendered “brought about a lack of restraint,” and “acted unfaithfully unfaithfulness” as “was very unfaithful.”
NASB keeps the Chronicles spelling “Tilgath-pilneser.” “Did not strengthen him” is rendered “instead of strengthening him.”
“Plundered” is rendered “took a portion out of,” and “not for help for him” as “it did not help him.” NASB supplies “Although.”
“At the time he harassed him” is rendered “in the time of his distress.”
“Causing his overthrow” is rendered “the downfall.”
NASB adds “when.”
“Every city and a city” is rendered “every city”; NASB supplies “to anger.”
“Matters” is rendered “acts.”
“Lay down” is rendered “slept,” and “graves” as “tombs.”
